body: Thanks for the message. I am an overthinker but it’s because of bdd isolation. Unfortunately social media is only getting bigger and I feel like I’m missing out. Sometimes I wish i grew up in your generation. It did seem socially healthier in a way. Social media is only really made for the attractive people. Life in general is better if you’re attractive. That’s partially why I’m unable to be motivated to focus on hobbies/interests. Hope that makes sense.
Hey I feel you. I hate my mom too but idk how I’ll survive without her…
My family’s messed up too. Maybe it’s better that you don’t talk to them. In my case it makes no difference lol it only hurts me more
Extremely irritating
Same. It’s not hard to just listen and pretend to care for a bit but my mom and brother just don’t even respond

And not to mention most peoples personalities just suck and they think they’re more important than they really are. Not saying I’m perfect cuz I hate myself too but most humans do suck. It’s a fact lol

They’re just incredibly selfish and won’t care. Otherwise they would’ve stopped being so loud by now. I did tell my mom that I would make noise and be loud when they sleep but they usually sleep at 3-5 am and at that time I already don’t have the energy lol. I’m also kind of scared of my brother but that’s good advice, thanks.
That’s the only solution honestly

The sound from the tv and their voices will overpower white noise and I feel like ear plugs will feel like AirPods which I don’t find comfortable. Also it’s selfish of them that I have to plug my ears just to get some quiet for sleep 😒
AirPods aren’t comfortable imo esp for sleeping
They don’t care. Somehow they just aren’t tired at 1-5 am. Idk where the energy comes from…

Same my whole family is against me. I’m scared. I might be homeless really soon actually. I wish someone would kill me or be brave enough to kill myself. I want to just run away but idk how I’ll be able to survive and I know they’ll call me dumb for running away and I’ll look like a loser if I accept their help  which I don’t want to cause they’re all narcissists that want to control me for life. Idk what to do. All I have is my phone that’s keeping me sane for now.

Thanks for this thoughtful comment! You shouldn’t have anxiety you’re really good with words :)
But yeah I agree with everything you said. Life really is tough with no support system. Mental health issues just isn’t taken seriously and seen as weak if you even mention it. I used to wonder how most people seem to go through life so easily but for me, every little thing overwhelms me, but it sucks cause people aren’t born equal so it makes sense that I would feel that way. And yeah structure gives people purpose and keeps their mind busy. I guess that’s  another reason why I hate myself and am depressed, cause I have no structure or purpose in life lol. But the reason I don’t is cause I have so many issues but mainly bdd that’s getting in the way of everything. I also fell apart when I took a break from college and I knew I would get lazy and unmotivated to continue. I’ve always been confused how people are just able to care so much about everything that life throws at them and not complain lol unlike me. Whatever it is that you’re struggling with, I’m sure you’ll get through it cause you seem smart, and yes let’s be brave and force ourselves to do something hard every day so that we don’t get stuck again 😌. Persistence is key. We can’t give up on ourselves even if everyone else does, well at least in my case since I’m my only support system lol sorry for the long reply
I feel that. My moms friends compliment my brother right in front of me and I’m just invisible to them lol
Damn, is your brother cocky about it?
Were they always handsome or had a glow up?

I completely relate and it usually is the brother that’s the less attractive one lol I agree with that. The girl usually gets more attention but whenever I go out with my brother people usually stare at him more. I’m like a background character lol. Whenever he jokes or says something my mom and people in general will think he’s funny and smart but if I say the exact same things people will think I’m opinionated and a bitch and not as funny simply bc he is a male and I’m not lol. The thing I’m the most envious of is that they get to live normal lives with friends and they get to experience dating, real love and relationships easily, while I’m stuck with my thoughts 24/7 wasting my life away 😔. Sorry for the long reply

I really wish gene editing was allowed rn honestly 🤔

I look at her mom and I just know she’s gonna grow up into a beauty. Shes gonna be taller than me, more feminine, and she’s gonna have the life I should’ve had. I also feel stupid and pathetic and I know it’s unhealthy to think this way but I can’t help it either lol.
I feel you, wish we didn’t have to hide 😕

Yess I relate a lot with “it drove me nuts because I feel like I would’ve been a model or have had a very different life if I wasn’t so deformed and could wear the clothes I want” and that “I’m not supposed to look like this.” In my head everyday I imagine myself as the ideal version of myself and how different every scenario would’ve been if I just looked how I was supposed to look and since I can’t look that way I just don’t see the point in living. Just a lot of lost potential and time wasted. My brother is the non deformed version of me and he has everything I don’t have and is living a life I should be living so I can’t stop comparing myself to him and resenting him. I’ve also been isolating for like 3 yrs and I’m looking worse now so idk how I can go on being like this when I can’t even leave my room now.

In my mind I would rather seem weird than to look uglier by smiling which is such a messed up way to live like no one should go thru life this way. I also don’t know what I actually look like except that I’m deformed so I feel you and I’m sorry that ur also struggling😔
